Trial.Public_title: Electrical Stimulation Exercise for Individuals With Lower Limb Paralysis
Trial.Scientific_title: Efficacy of Electrical Stimulation Exercise Training for Those With Lower Limb Paralysis
Trial.Study_design: Allocation: N/A. Intervention model: Single Group Assignment. Primary purpose: Treatment. Masking: None (Open Label).
Trial.Inclusion_Criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

- Lower limb paralysis due to SCI or other neurological disorder

- Greater than 18 years of age

- Innervated and excitable lower extremity muscles

Exclusion Criteria:

- Females that are pregnant

- Ventilator dependent

- Current pressure injuries that would be exacerbated by exercise

- History of spontaneous fractures

- Cardiovascular or pulmonary disease that would limit the ability to exercise

- Uncontrolled diabetes or hypertension

- Large body frame that would prevent participant from comfortably fitting the
exercise equipment

- Any other medical or psychological condition that would be a contraindication to
participating in an exercise program

Trial.Scientific_title: NeuroMSleepModeD Neuromodulation in patients with early stage depression and sleeping disturbances as well as multiple sclerosis - NeuroMSleepModeD
Trial.Study_design: Allocation: N/A: single arm study; Masking: Open (masking not used); Control: uncontrolled; Assignment: single; Study design purpose: basic science
Trial.Inclusion_Criteria:
Inclusion criteria: • Mild to moderate depressive symptoms, acute depressive episode (including sleep disturbances)
• (MS diagnosis)
• If applicable, diagnosis of depression for no more than 4 years
Trial.Exclusion_Criteria:
Exclusion criteria: • Use of psychiatric medications or sedative sleep aids
• Severe visual impairment
• Severe physical or other psychiatric conditions
• Alcohol or drug dependence
• Metal objects that are not compatible with MRI scans
